episodeTitle.en: An inside look at how Figma builds product | Yuhki Yamashita (CPO of Figma)
episodeTitle.zh: 内部视角：Figma如何打造产品 | 山下勇希（Yuhki Yamashita，Figma首席产品官）

guestBioOfficial.en: Yuhki Yamashita is Chief Product Officer at Figma. Prior to Figma, he was Head of Design of Uber’s New Mobility efforts, and before that a product manager at Google and Microsoft. Adding to his impressive resume, Yuhki also taught introductory computer science at Harvard. In today's episode, we talk about operationalizing quality, the case against OKRs, and how Figma isn't just known for product-led growth, but also for building a community of empowered users. Yuhki also shares why he thinks storytelling is key to being a great product manager, owning the "why," and the potential impact of Adobe's acquisition of Figma.
guestBioOfficial.zh:
山下勇基（Yuhki Yamashita）是Figma的首席产品官。在加入Figma之前，他曾担任Uber新出行业务的设计主管，此前还曾在谷歌和微软担任产品经理。除此之外，他还曾在哈佛大学教授计算机科学入门课程。  
在本期节目中，我们探讨了如何将质量体系化运作、反对OKR的理由，以及Figma为何不仅以产品驱动型增长闻名，还在构建一个赋权用户的社区。山下勇基还分享了为何他认为讲故事是成为优秀产品经理的关键，如何掌控"为什么"，以及Adobe收购Figma可能带来的影响。

title.en: An inside look at how Figma builds product | Yuhki Yamashita (CPO of Figma)

summary.en: Yuhki walks through how Figma builds product, including operationalizing quality, the case against OKRs (which he deprecated in favor of 'commitments' and headlines), and why Figma is known for both product-led growth and a community of empowered users. He shares why storytelling is key to being a great PM, owning the 'why,' and the potential impact of Adobe's acquisition of Figma. The episode is a detailed inside look at one of the most admired product teams.
summary.zh: Yuhki 逐步讲解了 Figma 如何打造产品，包括“将品质操作化”、反对 OKR 的理由（他以“承诺（commitments）”与“标题（headlines）”取而代之），以及为什么 Figma 既以产品驱动增长、又以支持用户的社区著称。他分享了为何讲故事是成为优秀 PM 的关键、拥有“为什么（why）”的重要性，以及 Adobe 收购 Figma 的潜在影响。本期是对最受钦佩的产品团队之一的、详尽的內部透视。
